# Milestone 3 — Scanner (plan, 2026-09-23)

## Context

School requirement: the camera, single-shot photo of a tile → identify → show
its card. Handoff screens 14–17: dark viewfinder with a tile-proportioned
frame, green corner brackets, « Cadrez une tuile », round shutter; result
bottom sheet (big tile, name « 5 de cercles rouge », mono subtitle
« AKA DORA · FAMILLE DES CERCLES », « Scanner une autre tuile »); failure
sheet (grey « ? » tile, « Tuile non reconnue », « RIEN D'IDENTIFIÉ », tips
line « Ça arrive. Essayez avec plus de lumière, la tuile bien à plat et seule
dans le cadre. », « Réessayer »). The Sensei panel on 15–16 is M5.

Decisions (brainstorming, user):
- Identifier is a **fake, deterministic from the photo bytes**: hash → one of
  the 34 tiles, ~1 in 5 → « non reconnue ». Interface stays for M5.
- **The result sheet is the card.** « Voir la fiche » and « Parcourir le
  catalogue des tuiles » are omitted in M3 (no such screens in the handoff);
  logged as deviations for M6.
- `image_picker` is the pre-approved dependency (CLAUDE.md §1.10). Latest on
  pub.dev: 1.2.3. It launches the **system camera app**, so the in-app
  "viewfinder" is a static dark screen whose shutter opens the camera; no live
  preview. Deviation to log (a live preview needs the `camera` package, not
  approved). No Android permission to declare: `image_picker` uses the camera
  intent; confirm in the package README once added.
- Scan history, Isar: M4. M3 keeps only the current scan in memory.

Working mode unchanged: user writes `lib/`, Claude tutors/reviews, test-writer
writes tests, Claude does docs. One new dependency: say `image_picker ^1.2.3`,
why, and get approval before `flutter pub add` (Task 1).

## Layout (flat feature folder, mirrors `lib/yaku/`)

```
lib/scanner/tile_photo_source.dart      abstract TilePhotoSource { Future<Uint8List?> capture(); }
lib/scanner/tile_photo_source_impl.dart image_picker: pickImage(source: camera, imageQuality, maxWidth) → bytes
lib/scanner/tile_identifier.dart        abstract TileIdentifier { Future<Tile?> identify(Uint8List photo); }
lib/scanner/fake_tile_identifier.dart   deterministic hash → Tile or null; M5 swaps in firebase_ai
lib/scanner/scan_state.dart             freezed sealed ScanState: idle | analysing | found(Tile) | notFound
lib/scanner/scanner_providers.dart      tilePhotoSourceProvider, tileIdentifierProvider, scanProvider (Notifier)
lib/scanner/tile_labels.dart            tileName(Tile) « 5 de cercles rouge », tileFamily(Tile) « famille des cercles »
lib/scanner/scanner_screen.dart         replaces the placeholder: viewfinder + result/failure sheet
```

`ScanState` in its own file like `lesson_session.dart`; labels in their own file
because the screen and the tests both need them (public, two consumers).

## Data flow

```
shutter tap → scanProvider.notifier.scan()
  state = analysing (shutter disabled)
  bytes = await photoSource.capture()        null (user cancelled) → idle
  tile  = await identifier.identify(bytes)   null → notFound, else found(tile)
« Scanner une autre tuile » / « Réessayer » → scan() again (state analysing…)
tab switch: state kept (IndexedStack + non-autodispose notifier), like the Dex
```

`ScanNotifier extends Notifier<ScanState>`, `build() => const ScanState.idle()`;
`scan()` is the one method. Errors from the picker (platform exception) →
`notFound` too: the user sees the failure sheet with « Réessayer », never a
red screen. Fake identifier: `bytes.fold(17, (h, b) => h * 31 + b)`; `% 5 == 0`
→ null; else index `% 34` → tile (suits × 1–9 = 27, honours 1–7). Red five when
the hash says so for a 5 (adds « rouge »).

## Tile labels

`tileName(Tile)`: number tiles « {n} de {caractères|cercles|bambous} »
(+ « rouge » when red); honours: 1–4 « Vent d'est / du sud / de l'ouest /
du nord », 5–7 « Dragon blanc / vert / rouge ». `tileFamily(Tile)`:
« famille des caractères / cercles / bambous », « honneurs ». Pure functions,
switch on `TileSuit` with no default.
